title: Two-Bay Fresh Market Handoff Preset
description: Static game layout: two complete published produce stalls, shared rear prep table with whole produce kit, and two side-pocket two-crate stacks. Separate front public and rear external handoff/storage interfaces. Stall interior has nominal 1.95m beam clearance and does not pass a 1.95m-body workflow. Exterior routes terminate at handoff points outside canopy. External flat ground Z=0 required. Seven named game ports and full reserved-route data are embedded in the GLB. Custom regions use preset-local Blender Z-up metres and map to glTF Y-up by (x,y,z) to (x,z,-y). No moving navigation, accessibility, commercial, load or dynamics certification.
